## What's new

- NES, SNES, Genesis, Master System and TurboGrafx-16 have a new Style row
  in their Shader menu: crt-lottes-fast, or Scanlines, plain scanlines that
  cost the CPU about a tenth as much. Use it if a game slows down.
- The in-game Shader menu shows Speed: Full Speed, Near the Limit or Too
  Slow, with the shader's time and the whole frame's time. Just after a
  change it's an estimate (est.); play a moment and pause again to measure.

---

ChaOS 0.9.4 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Install or update** with [ChaOS Installer](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS-Installer/releases/latest), or write `ChaOS-v0.9.4-brick.img.xz` to a card yourself (that erases it).

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.1.1](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.1.1) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v0.9.4-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).
